<thought>The dominant ion at m/z 193.1103 is likely the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the proton mass (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral mass of ≈192.103 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈12.5 % M+1 intensity) matches a molecule containing about 12 carbons (≈1.1 % per carbon). A formula that matches the exact mass and isotopic pattern is C₁₂H₁₆O₂ (calculated monoisotopic mass = 192.1150 Da, within typical experimental tolerance). This formula also yields a DBE of 5, consistent with a plausible structure.</thought>
<final_answer>C12H16O2</final_answer>
